definitions: To remove something from a place or container.
To go on a date with someone.
To obtain an official document or service.
To destroy or disable something or someone.
To withdraw money from an account.
To escort someone to a social event or place.
examples: He asked her to take out for dinner.
She needs to take out a loan for her business.
The sniper managed to take out the target.
I need to take out some cash from the ATM.
They will take out their clients for lunch.
